'''February 2001 Lindon tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local (booster draft) held in The CCG Farm, Lindon, Utah on 10 February 2001. [[Casey Barson]] won it. It is known from Casey Barson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1767">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-23-smeg-eats-lindon-apart-kinda-02-10-01d1767/ smeg-eats-lindon-apart-kinda-02-10-01], DeckTech (Casey "Smeg" Barson, 23 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-23-smeg-eats-lindon-apart-kinda-02-10-01d1767/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 February 2001
* '''Site:''' The CCG Farm, Lindon, Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Casey Barson]]
